$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：破軍.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 破軍在遷移宮，你在外要靠專門技能起家。
rules.en: With Po Jun in your Travel Palace, you make your way away from home through a specialist skill.

rules.text: 破軍見｛天魁天鉞｝最吉，你的技能有發揮的機會，而且受人賞識。
rules.en: Po Jun with ｛Tian Kui or Tian Yue｝ is the best case: your skills get their chance, and people value them.

source.quote: 主自己的技能有发挥的机会

rules.text: 破軍化祿，你可以憑專門技能在異鄉立足。
rules.en: Po Jun in Abundance: your specialist skill lets you put down roots far from home.

source.quote: 则可藉专门技能在异乡立足

rules.text: 破軍沒有化祿，你不利在異地落地生根，卻利於在各地流動生財。
rules.en: Po Jun without Abundance: putting down roots elsewhere is not for you, but moving between places to earn is.

source.quote: 但却利流动各地以生财

rules.text: 破軍化權，你宜在外地憑技藝為人服務。
rules.en: Po Jun in Authority: away from home, serve others through a skill.

source.quote: 宜在异乡凭技艺为人服务

rules.text: 同宮有｛火星或鈴星｝，你在外容易漂泊。
rules.en: With ｛Huo Xing or Ling Xing｝ in the palace, you tend to drift when away from home.

rules.text: 同宮有｛擎羊或陀羅｝，你在外容易破耗。
rules.en: With ｛Qing Yang or Tuo Luo｝ in the palace, you tend to lose money when away from home.
